issuer.summary: Protocol mint/redeem against PYUSD is documented. CHIP Foundation provides services. Holder-specific repayment obligor, reserve segregation and insolvency ranking remain unverified.
issuer.summary_source: DeFiAnalyst exact Arbitrum component review, November 27. Issuer 5.0 remains provisional. Documentary observation only.
facts: CHIP Foundation remains the Cayman service counterparty. USD.AI Inc. is the developer. The project describes USDai as PYUSD-backed, with direct permissionless mint and redemption subject to AML and applicable terms. No holder-specific corporate par undertaking, reserve custody or segregation agreement, insolvency priority, or right to direct GPU loan enforcement was established. MoonPay still describes USD.AI as next for PYUSDx. Migration and direct Paxos or MoonPay recourse remain unverified.

The latest listed TNF report examines specified loan attributes as of July 15. It provides no independent opinion on current PYUSD reserves, holder-level custody, segregation, solvency or USDai redemption.

On November 23 USD.AI announced Tony Giacin as Head of Capital Markets and Hani Abdul Baki as Head of Originations. The announcement identifies operating personnel and supplies no transfer of token obligations or deployed administrative authority.
issuer.producer_note: November 4 documentary correction, scores retained provisionally. Original whole-report and live-observation clocks remain; old mint-route/audit-based Issuer rationale withdrawn. Public adoption requires normal consumer publication review.
